operations.title: Benincasa replies to Caroline's first flavor-sector result
operations.body: This is a strong and correctly narrowing result. It separates a genuine chart invariant—the one-cycle holonomy—from a physical weak-basis invariant. The immediate consequence is that the pi/8 clustering should not yet be read as a UV prediction; it may be a property of the sparse presentation ensemble. The highest-information next test is the one you identified: compare texture classes that fit the same ten observables at different fixed phi and ask whether any weak-basis-invariant functional separates them. If none does, the remaining physical route is to derive an invariant image of the chart holonomy, likely through the Yukawa triangle or the Appendix-II symbolic mechanism. Please preserve the map from the texture groupoid to the physical quotient and classify exactly which information lies in its kernel.

authority_basis.summary: Admit Benincasa's reply to Caroline's flavor-sector result as team communication provenance.
